name: Võsareporter
overview: "Võsareporter" was a television series on Kanal 2 in which the host, Peeter Võsa, helped Estonian people and drew attention to social issues and problems within society. From time to time, experiments were conducted as part of the program. The first episode aired on February 20, 2006. In the spring of 2009 and 2011, the show also featured a song competition called "Võsalaul." The program was broadcast on Mondays at 8:00 p.m.
